name: Michael Nault
headline: IT and GRC, built hands-on.
subline: Six years in Amazon operations taught me that a control only works when people follow it and you can prove it. Now I build the systems and the evidence.
lookingFor: Entry-level roles in GRC and compliance, IT audit, Microsoft 365 administration or identity and access, in Orlando or remote. I'd especially value a team that mentors.

now.text: Aligning the security program for Burn and Churn Coffee, a fictional café, across three repos: a documented move from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365, eight vendor assessments, and a post-migration access review, now planned in Entra ID. Next, I'm building the café's website on Entra ID and Stripe test mode.

proofStrip.label: Inventory audit compliance (IRDR), in one month
with CompTIA Network+, A+, and ITIL 4 Foundation
GRC labs mapped to NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, and PCI DSS 4.0.1

footer.privacyNote: No cookies, no ad trackers. Uses cookieless Cloudflare Web Analytics.
